subject: Chemistry
curriculumBasis: Curated chapter-level simulations based on NCERT/CBSE 2026-27 topics. Classes 6-9 follow the current NCERT science series; Classes 11-12 follow CBSE Chemistry 2026-27. Class 5 entries are foundational app activities. Practical modules and a small number of established supplementary activities are retained.

experiments.title: Materials Around Us
experiments.description: Compare everyday materials by visible properties and suitable uses.

experiments.title: States of Matter
experiments.description: Heat or cool a model substance and observe changes between solid, liquid and gas.

experiments.title: Changes Around Us
experiments.description: Classify everyday changes and explore which changes can be reversed.

experiments.title: Materials Around Us: Solubility and Properties
experiments.description: Test everyday materials for properties such as solubility, transparency and flexibility.

experiments.title: A Journey Through States of Water
experiments.chapter: A Journey Through States of Water
experiments.description: Change heating and cooling conditions to explore melting, freezing, evaporation and condensation.

experiments.title: Methods of Separation in Everyday Life
experiments.chapter: Methods of Separation in Everyday Life
experiments.description: Choose suitable methods such as filtration, sieving, sedimentation and evaporation for different mixtures.

experiments.title: Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic and Neutral
experiments.chapter: Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic and Neutral
experiments.description: Test virtual samples with natural indicators and compare acidic, basic and neutral behaviour.

experiments.title: The World of Metals and Non-metals
experiments.chapter: The World of Metals and Non-metals
experiments.description: Compare metal and non-metal properties and explore conductivity, reactivity and material uses.

experiments.title: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical
experiments.chapter: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical
experiments.description: Compare physical changes with chemical reactions and identify evidence of a new substance.

experiments.title: Neutralisation Reactions
experiments.chapter: Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic and Neutral
experiments.description: Mix measured virtual acid and base samples to explore neutralisation and indicator changes.

experiments.title: Particulate Nature of Matter
experiments.description: Explore particles, spacing, motion and temperature in solids, liquids and gases.

experiments.title: Elements, Compounds and Mixtures
experiments.chapter: Nature of Matter: Elements, Compounds and Mixtures
experiments.description: Build and compare elements, compounds and mixtures using particle-level models.

experiments.title: The World of Solutes, Solvents and Solutions
experiments.chapter: The Amazing World of Solutes, Solvents and Solutions
experiments.description: Change solute, solvent and temperature to explore dissolving, solubility and concentration.

experiments.title: Combustion, Flame and Ignition
experiments.description: Explore the conditions for combustion and compare flame zones in a safe virtual model.

experiments.title: Exploring Mixtures and Their Separation
experiments.description: Compare solutions, suspensions and colloids and select suitable methods to separate mixture components.

experiments.title: Journey Inside the Atom
experiments.description: Explore subatomic particles, atomic models, atomic number and mass number.

experiments.title: Atomic Foundations of Matter
experiments.description: Use particle models and balanced reactions to explore atoms, molecules, formulae and conservation of mass.

experiments.title: Chemical Reactions and Equations
experiments.description: Build and balance equations and explore combination, decomposition, displacement and double displacement reactions.

experiments.title: Acids, Bases and Salts: pH Playground
experiments.description: Test virtual solutions, use indicators and explore pH, neutralisation and everyday salts.

experiments.title: Metals and Non-metals
experiments.description: Compare reactivity, displacement reactions, ionic compounds and corrosion using virtual metals.

experiments.title: Carbon and Its Compounds
experiments.description: Build simple carbon structures and explore covalent bonding, functional groups and common reactions.

experiments.title: Periodic Classification of Elements
experiments.description: Arrange elements and explore groups, periods and trends in a visual periodic table.

experiments.title: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
experiments.description: Explore the mole concept, molar mass, concentration and stoichiometric calculations.

experiments.title: Structure of Atom
experiments.description: Explore atomic models, electron configurations, quantum numbers and electronic transitions.

experiments.title: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
experiments.chapter: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
experiments.description: Explore the periodic table and compare atomic size, ionisation tendency and other periodic trends.

experiments.title: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
experiments.description: Build molecules and explore ionic bonding, covalent bonding, VSEPR shapes and hybridisation.

experiments.title: Chemical Thermodynamics
experiments.description: Explore heat, work, internal energy and enthalpy changes in model chemical processes.

experiments.title: Equilibrium
experiments.description: Change concentration, pressure and temperature to explore chemical equilibrium and Le Chatelier's principle.

experiments.title: Redox Reactions
experiments.description: Track electron transfer, oxidation numbers and balancing of redox reactions.

experiments.title: Organic Chemistry: Basic Principles and Techniques
experiments.chapter: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
experiments.description: Explore organic structures, functional groups, purification and qualitative identification.

experiments.title: Hydrocarbons
experiments.description: Build alkane, alkene and alkyne models and compare structure, isomerism and reactions.

experiments.title: Virtual Titration Lab

experiments.title: Basic Laboratory Techniques
experiments.description: Practise virtual measurement, transfer, filtration and selection of laboratory apparatus.

experiments.title: Qualitative Salt Analysis
experiments.description: Use a guided virtual test sequence to identify common cations and anions from observations.

experiments.title: Solutions

experiments.title: Electrochemistry
experiments.description: Build galvanic and electrolytic cells and explore cell potential, conductance and electrolysis.

experiments.title: Chemical Kinetics
experiments.description: Change concentration, temperature and catalysts to investigate reaction rate and rate laws.

experiments.title: d- and f-Block Elements
experiments.description: Explore transition-metal configurations, oxidation states, colours and periodic trends.

experiments.title: Coordination Compounds

experiments.title: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes
experiments.description: Build molecular structures and explore substitution and elimination reaction pathways.

experiments.title: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
experiments.description: Compare structures and explore selected reactions of alcohols, phenols and ethers.

experiments.title: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
experiments.description: Build carbonyl compounds and explore characteristic reactions and functional-group tests.

experiments.title: Amines
experiments.description: Explore amine structures, basicity and selected reactions using interactive molecular models.

experiments.title: Biomolecules
experiments.description: Explore the structures and building blocks of carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids.

experiments.title: Redox Titration
experiments.description: Perform a virtual redox titration and inspect the end point, readings and calculated result.

experiments.title: Paper Chromatography of Plant Pigments
experiments.description: Change solvent and sample settings to observe pigment separation on chromatography paper.

experiments.title: Organic Functional Group Analysis
experiments.description: Use simulated observations from common functional-group tests to identify an unknown organic sample.

experiments.title: Comprehensive Salt Analysis
experiments.description: Follow a virtual qualitative-analysis workflow and interpret observations for salt identification.
